query:
WITH RECURSIVE subtree(id, lvl) AS (
            SELECT id, 0 FROM identities WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT i.id, s.lvl + 1
            FROM identities i
            INNER JOIN subtree s ON i.parent_id = s.id
            WHERE i.org_id = $2 AND s.lvl < $3
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!" FROM subtree
